description: 국토교통부_도로전광표지(VMS) 정보 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부. 도로에 설치된 가변전광표지판(VMS)은 실시간 교통정보를 운전자에게 시각적으로 전달하는 주요 수단으로, 돌발사고, 정체 구간, 기상 악화, 공사 및 통제구간 등 다양한 정보를 신속하게. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토교통부. Its tags are VMS 표출정보, 가변전광표지판 표출정보, 도로 VMS, 실시간 교통안내, 돌발상황표출. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-06-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
